mechanism: Lopinavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase lisdexamfetamine metabolite (dexamfetamine) levels, potentially increasing sympathomimetic and CNS stimulant effects; additive cardiovascular stimulation risk.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and CNS effects; consider dose reduction of lisdexamfetamine or alternative antiretroviral therapy if interaction effects occur.
